{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check shape and basic info
print(f"Shape: {df.shape}")
print(f"Number of unique patients: {df['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Number of rows: {len(df)}")

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {(df['patient_id'].duplicated()).sum()}")

# Check sample_seq distribution
print(f"Sample_seq max: {df['sample_seq'].max()}")
print(f"Sample_seq min: {df['sample_seq'].min()}")

# Check assay_batch
print(f"Assay batch distribution:\n{df['assay_batch'].value_counts()}")

# Check biomarker_final for batch B
print(f"biomarker_final min in batch B: {df.loc[df['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'].min()}")
print(f"biomarker_final max in batch B: {df.loc[df['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final'].max()}")

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline (just to confirm)
print(f"Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()}")"}
